data_fields.name: levelGapMax
data_fields.donor_constant: 14 (items; adena has its own config, default 14)

data_fields.name: entry.min_max
data_fields.donor_constant: per entry; Rnd.get(min,max) with exclusive max (table data)

best_idea: Give each kill a fixed number of rare-drop slots and gate the whole table by a killer-to-victim level gap, so rare loot is capped per kill and a killer far above the mob gets nothing.
decision_why: Keep the per-kill rare cap (zone data), the level-gap filter (engine constant) and the top-dealer recipient rule; drop the eviction displacement, the group running-total roll and the dead party branch, which make drop odds depend on table order and do not give the stated chances.
acceptance: Server test with a seeded RNG: a 20/30/50 group over 100k kills lands within 1 point of each stated chance; a killer 15 levels above a level-3 mob never gets a rare drop; a raid zone with cap 7 never yields more than 7 rare drops per kill; among at most three attackers the top dealer gets the drop when online, else the last attacker.
